assignmentTitle: Design of a Cotter Joint for a Bicycle

criteria.title: Project Charter & Real-World Observation
criteria.description: Understanding client brief, bicycle pedal-crank-spindle real-world system observation, and project scope.

criteria.title: Power Transmission Path Identification
criteria.description: Correct identification of the mechanical load sequence from pedal force to drive chainring.

criteria.title: Cotter Joint Component Identification
criteria.description: Accurate labeling of crank arm, crank eye, spindle, cotter pin, retaining nut, chainring, and pedal on EA-10.

criteria.title: Working Principle & Joint Function
criteria.description: Understanding wedge action, friction lock, and torque transmission without relative rotation.

criteria.title: Applied Pedal Force & Torque Analysis
criteria.description: Calculation of maximum transmitted torque and tangential force at spindle surface.

criteria.title: Design Requirements & Engineering Assumptions
criteria.description: Formulation of valid engineering assumptions regarding material strengths, allowable stresses, and FoS.

criteria.title: Cotter Joint Design & Stress Calculations
criteria.description: Calculation of double shear stress and crushing/bearing stress in the cotter pin.

criteria.title: Strength & Factor of Safety Check
criteria.description: Determination of actual Factor of Safety against allowable material limits.

criteria.title: Engineering Judgement & Design Recommendation
criteria.description: Evaluation of joint safety, critical failure mode identification, and design improvements.

criteria.title: Final Engineering Summary Report
criteria.description: Synthesizing concise engineering summary report with recommendations for assembly and maintenance.
